turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hello Leander, I can help you find your print. To look up your order, please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

I am sorry, Leander, but I cannot look up orders by name. To find your order and its tracking link, I need both the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email the order was placed with. Without them I cannot share any order details. If you can find the order number in your confirmation email, I can check it as soon as you send it together with that email.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I am sorry, Leander, but I cannot share the delivery address, the shipping status or any other details about an order until you are verified. To verify, I need the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email the order was placed with. Once you send both, I can check the order for you.
